title: Ich und mein Alltag
can_do: introduce yourself (work, family, hobbies); describe your daily routine; ask others about theirs
grammar: present tense incl. irregular + separable verbs; verb second and inversion

title: Wohnen
can_do: describe your flat and where things are; report a problem in the flat; understand a flat advert
grammar: Wechselpräpositionen (wo?/wohin?, liegen/legen, stehen/stellen); Perfekt haben vs sein

title: Einkaufen und Dienstleistungen
can_do: compare products and prices; ask for advice in a shop; return or exchange something
grammar: dative verbs (gefallen, passen, helfen) + dative pronouns; comparative and superlative

title: Freizeit und Verabredungen
can_do: make, accept and decline plans; give reasons; write a short informal message
grammar: subordinate clauses with weil, dass, wenn (verb last); modal verbs incl. Präteritum

title: Module test 1
can_do: everything in U01–U04
grammar: cumulative
exam_task: Lesen T1 + T3, mixed check U01–U04

title: Arbeit und Beruf
can_do: describe your job and workplace; talk about tasks and colleagues; talk about likes and dislikes at work
grammar: adjective endings (definite/indefinite/zero article); deshalb/trotzdem (inversion)

title: Bewerbung und Arbeitssuche
can_do: understand a job advert; ask polite questions on the phone; write a short application email
grammar: Konjunktiv II politeness (könnten, würden, hätte gern); indirect questions (ob / W-word)

title: Gesundheit
can_do: describe symptoms; make and change a doctor's appointment; understand advice and instructions
grammar: reflexive verbs; verbs with prepositions + da-/wo- compounds; sollen/sollten for advice

title: Unterwegs: Mobilität und Reisen
can_do: buy tickets and ask for connections; understand delays and changes; tell a travel story
grammar: als vs wenn vs wann; Präteritum of common verbs; time prepositions (seit, vor, für, ab)

title: Medien und Kommunikation
can_do: talk about media habits; give and justify an opinion on media; summarise a short article
grammar: relative clauses (nominative/accusative); opinion phrases (meiner Meinung nach …)

title: Module test 2
can_do: everything in U01–U09 (weighted to U05–U09)
grammar: cumulative

title: Ämter und Behörden
can_do: fill in a form; understand rules and letters from offices; ask what documents you need
grammar: zu-infinitive; um … zu / damit; müssen/dürfen for rules

title: Aus- und Weiterbildung
can_do: talk about your education and plans; compare course options; present a topic in five steps
grammar: relative clauses (dative, with preposition); Konjunktiv II for wishes and advice

title: Gefühle, Haltungen, Meinungen
can_do: express feelings and attitudes; agree and disagree politely; write an opinion post
grammar: obwohl vs trotzdem; n-declension; two-way opinion structure (einerseits … andererseits)

title: Konflikte lösen und beschweren
can_do: complain politely; negotiate a solution; plan something together with someone
grammar: Konjunktiv II requests and proposals (wie wäre es, wenn …); aber vs sondern

title: Banken und Versicherungen
can_do: open an account and understand conditions; report damage or a lost card; understand a contract summary
grammar: passive present (wird gemacht); indefinite pronouns (man, jemand, niemand)

title: Module test 3
can_do: everything in U01–U14 (weighted to U10–U14)
grammar: cumulative

title: Familie, Kinder und Schule
can_do: talk to a teacher or childcare; describe family life and changes; tell what happened before what
grammar: passive past + passive with modal verb; Plusquamperfekt with nachdem

title: Umwelt und Zusammenleben
can_do: discuss environmental habits; understand house rules and neighbour issues; suggest improvements
grammar: genitive + wegen, während, trotz; während vs wegen in texts

title: Feste, Kultur und Traditionen
can_do: describe a festival or tradition; compare customs; give a short presentation
grammar: two-part connectors (nicht nur … sondern auch, sowohl … als auch, je … desto)

title: Leben in Deutschland
can_do: talk about your experience of moving; describe plans and predictions; give advice to newcomers
grammar: Futur I; lassen (+ infinitive); Konjunktiv II for advice

title: Technik und Alltag
can_do: explain a problem with a device; follow instructions; talk about what would have been better
